div.p: Everything most people ask before putting Odoo in their pocket.

div.div: Yes. Odoo Mobile Client is free to download and free to use, with no user limit and no trial period. The Advanced edition is also a free download — you only pay for its server module on the Odoo App Store.

h2.button: Do I need to have Odoo to use the app?

div.p: Yes. Odoo Mobile Client is an access client: it connects to an Odoo server that you or your company control, and it does not host any data of its own.

h2.button: Do I need to change anything on my Odoo server?

div.div: One small step: install the connector module from the Odoo App Store on your server — odoo_mobile_client (free) for the Free edition, or odoo_mobile_client_advanced (one-time purchase) for Advanced, which brings the free module along with it. After that, everyone just signs in from the app. Your data still never leaves your server.

h2.button: Does it work with Odoo Enterprise, Odoo.sh and Community?

div.div: Yes — Community and Enterprise, wherever they are hosted (Odoo.sh or your own hosting). OMC Free supports Odoo 12 to 19+, and OMC Advanced supports Odoo 17 to 19+. If you are unsure about your specific setup, write to us and we will confirm.

h2.button: Where are my username and password stored?

div.div: Only on your phone, inside the operating system's secure storage (Keychain on iOS, Keystore on Android). They are sent only to the Odoo server you configure — never to us or to anyone else. See the Privacy Policy for details.

h2.button: Can other people in my company use it too?

div.div: Yes — everyone with an Odoo account in your company can install the app and sign in. Each person sees exactly what their Odoo permissions allow, just like on a computer.

h2.button: Can I connect more than one Odoo server?

div.div: Yes. The Free edition saves up to two servers — for example two companies, or a production and a test environment — and switches between them without typing credentials again. If you need more, the Advanced edition removes the limit.

h2.button: What does the Advanced edition add?

div.div: Advanced turns the app into your company's own: unlimited saved servers, in-app branding (your colors, and your logo and company name in the side menu) managed from Odoo, push notifications for activities and messages, onboarding by QR code, barcode and document scanners, and management of the connected devices. It is a one-time purchase and it is available now — get it from the Download page.
Write to contact@pachedev.com or use the contact form on this site. Include your phone model and, if possible, a screenshot — it helps us answer faster.

div.p: We are happy to help before and after you install.
